name: @aion/personal-context
description: Owner-approved personal context: explicit source authorization, bounded synchronization, provenance, freshness, conflict tracking, and provider-scoped retrieval

scripts.typecheck: npm run build --workspace @aion/director && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json --noEmit
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/**/*.test.js"
scripts.test:contracts: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/contracts.test.js"
scripts.test:boundary: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/path-boundary.test.js"
scripts.test:sync: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/sync.test.js"
scripts.test:reconcile: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/reconcile.test.js"
scripts.test:retrieval: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/retrieval.test.js"
scripts.test:persistence: npm run build && npm run build:test && node --test --test-reporter=tap "dist-test/test/persistence.test.js"
